budget.accounting: Sum of wall time of our GPU subprocesses, including startup, validation, and shared-device delays. Unused earlier allocations may fund later mandatory work; refinement never exceeds one device-hour. No new confirmation job starts without reserving one device-hour for benchmarking and audit.

training.objective: Equal arithmetic/language weighting; normalized raw MLP MSE plus native normalized post-MLP contribution MSE
training.precision: FP32 training and BF16 deployed inference; no TF32

development.activation_source: Previous corrected train/selection activations; all previously inspected evaluations are development only

screen.rule: An architecture is promising if at least one activation passes all development checks and both fits are finite. Both activations advance together. Rank architectures by mean fractional objective improvement over their matching bottleneck controls; ties favor shortcut. Advance at most one new architecture, with bottleneck controls.

refinement.rule: Prioritize extending both activations of the leading architecture and bottleneck control when their best checkpoint is in the last 10% of updates. Retain extended effort only when both leading-architecture activations improve objective by at least 2% without worsening either error term. If an architecture passed the downstream screen and refinement budget remains, screen depth two for it and its bottleneck controls at identical effort. Never choose activation-specific depth or effort. Use development only.

confirmation.arc_source: Unused official ARC-Easy train questions, excluding old IDs and normalized question hashes
confirmation.exclusion: All historical and previous operand pairs including counterfactual donors; all previous document hashes and hostnames; all previous QA IDs and question hashes
confirmation.parser: Frozen integer-only parser; malformed responses count as errors

acceptance.multiplicity: 5 endpoints times 3 seeds per activation; conservative Clopper-Pearson bound on paired regressions, plus document and hostname-clustered CE bounds
acceptance.eml_specific_advantage: Requires consistent paired confirmation gains over matched SiLU with uncertainty and comparable measured cost; observational activation improvement alone is insufficient

benchmark.optimization: Same native eager SDPA, folded affine statistics, and cheaper exact matrix collapses for every baseline; entire model on GPU. Warmed allocator and synchronized timing. Loading, tokenization and service queuing excluded.

scope: Single-block architecture and efficiency study. No arithmetic-mechanism discovery or claims of recovered algorithms. Failed or budget-limited candidates remain reported. No fitting or selection on fresh confirmation.
